skills.name: First Form: Water Surface Slash (壱ノ型・水面斬り)
skills.description: Tanjiro attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 90% of his ATK. He uses the most optimal skill depending on the target's status.

upgrades.text: The skill Second Form: Water Wheel is unlocked.
The skill Fifth Form: Blessed Rain After the Drought is unlocked.
The skill Seventh Form: Piercing Rain Drop is unlocked.

skills.name: Second Form: Water Wheel (弐ノ型・水車)
skills.description: When Tanjiro receives damage, and he is not immobile, he has a 30% chance to use Water Wheel to reduce the damage by 70%. Then he counter-attacks the the source of the damage, dealing damage equal to 60% of his ATK and gains 1 layer of Total Concentration. Each time Tanjiro's HP is reduced by 20%, the chance of triggering Water Wheel increases by 20%.

skills.name: Fifth Form: Blessed Rain After the Drought (伍ノ型・干天の慈雨)
skills.description: Tanjiro attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. If the target's HP is below 30%, the damage is increased by 40%.

skills.name: Seventh Form: Piercing Rain Drop (漆ノ型・雫波紋突き)
skills.description: Tanjiro attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. If the target's HP is above 70%, the damage is increased by 40%.

skills.name: Third Form: Flowing Dance (参ノ型・流流舞い)
skills.description: Tanjiro attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 75% of his ATK with each attack.

upgrades.text: The skill Fourth Form: Striking Tide is unlocked.
The skill Sixth Form: Whirlpool is unlocked.
The skill Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin is unlocked.
The skill Ninth Form: Splashing Water Flow - Turbulent is unlocked.

skills.name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide (肆ノ型・打ち潮)
skills.description: At the start of Tanjiro's turn in [[Main Story|Explore]] battles, he attacks all enemies dealing damage equal to 210% of his ATK.

skills.name: Sixth Form: Whirlpool (陸ノ型・ねじれ渦)
skills.description: At the start of Tanjiro's turn and if he is inflicted with a control effect, he uses Whirlpool to remove all control effects from himself and gains a new turn.

skills.name: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin (捌ノ型・滝壷)
skills.description: If there are 3 or less enemies, the skill Flowing Dance will be replaced by Waterfall Basin. Tanjiro attacks all enemies 4 times, dealing damage equal to 75% of his ATK with each attack.

skills.name: Ninth Form: Splashing Water Flow - Turbulent (玖ノ型・水流飛沫・乱)
skills.description: Tanjiro gains 30% of Crit RES and at the end of a non-summoned entities' turn his move bar is increased by 3%.

skills.name: Tenth Form: Constant Flux (拾ノ型・生生流転)
skills.description: Tanjiro attacks an enemy 5 times, with the first 4 hits dealing damage equal to 50%/60%/70%/80% and the final hit dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK. Also gains 1 layer of Total Concentration at the end of his turn. ; : ;Total Concentration : :'''Buff, Mark''': Each layer increases the final hit of Constant Flux by 30%. The skill Hinokami Kagura is unlocked at 9 layers.

upgrades.text: Damage for the final hit increases to 90%.
Damage for the final hit increases to 100%.
Damage for the final hit increases to 110%.
Damage for the final hit increases to 120%.

skills.name: Hinokami Kagura (ヒノカミ神楽)
skills.description:
Tanjiro attacks an enemy 5 times, with the first 4 hits dealing damage equal to 50%/60%/70%/80% of the target's max HP and the final hit dealing true damage equal to 99% of the target's max HP (cannot exceed 1000% of his ATK).
This skill can only be used once per battle.

bio.condition: In PVN zones, use every Water Breathing technique and Hinokami Kagura.
Team Tanjiro with another players's Nezuko Kamado and clear any zone 10 times.
